name: Shortage
description: The clinic is out of dressings. Bring me some from the field, sealed and clean.
success: Sealed, clean, not a speck of grit. You'd be amazed how rare that is.

name: Factory Walk
description: Before I send nurses to the factory I want to know two rooms are still standing: the med bay and the overseer's office. Then leave by Gate 3, it's the way they'll come.
success: Still standing. Good. Fewer surprises for my people.

name: Clean Hands
description: Bringing me bandages is a start. Making your own is better. Set up a Medstation in your hideout and put together two AI-2 kits on it. Clean hands, mind.
success: Two kits, properly packed. Now you waste less of mine.

name: Carry Out
description: Find a Salewa out there and bring it back out of the factory on you. Keep it, I only need proof they're still on the shelves.
success: Sealed and dated. Someone's still stocking that place.

name: Sanitary Standards
description: Proper surgical kits, found on site, not bought from Auntie Zoya's cousins.
success: A real surgical kit. I could cry, if I had the time.

name: House Calls
description: There's a field clinic on the Test Yard that used to be mine. Leave a first-aid kit on its table for whoever stumbles in next, and come back out so I don't have to patch you too.
success: Someone used it already. A Scav, probably. A patched Scav is still a patched person.

name: Clinic Supplies
description: The field clinic runs on whatever you bring. IV sets and a working eye scope, found out there, sealed.
success: Blood sets and a scope. The clinic will run another month on this.

name: Trusted Hands
description: Earn my trust, then show me you can work: a surgical kit from your own Medstation.
success: Neat stitches on the packaging. You'll do. My suppliers will sell you Hawkeye now.

name: Dorm Pharmacy
description: The customs dorms had a nurse's cupboard on every floor. Go through the dorms and carry one morphine out with you, found there, so I know the cupboards aren't empty yet.
success: Morphine, still in date. Somebody up there still thinks ahead.

name: Crash Site
description: A medevac helicopter went down in the woods with a full kit on board. Reach the wreck, bring me back medical tools found there, and leave the bodies. I've seen enough of them.
success: Tools from the wreck. They'll save someone. They didn't save the crew.

name: East Wing
description: The resort's east wing was a hospital for a week before it was a battlefield. Walk it, clear four Scavs out of my way and get off that shore alive. I'll send nurses when you say it's safe.
success: Safe is a strong word. Safer will do.

name: Specimens
description: Whatever they did in Lab Zero's research wing, they kept samples in the vault below it. I want to know both rooms are still sealed. Look, don't touch, and come back up.
success: Sealed. Good. Some doors should stay shut.

name: Field Hospital
description: I'm opening a proper ward. I need a Medstation that can make real kits, two AFAKs off it to prove it, and a defibrillator found out there. Then I'll trust you with my best.
success: A ward with a working defibrillator. I'd forgotten the sound it makes.

name: The Last Ward
description: One more thing and the ward is finished: a LEDX and two ophthalmoscopes, found in the field, sealed. Do this and you'll have the one injector I keep for the day everything goes wrong.
success: The ward is finished. Here. Use it on the day, not before.
